en: The Section of Threes, Chapter on Intention (Saṅkappavagga)
9. The Birth Story of Tirīṭavaccha “He possesses nothing consisting of knowledge;
he has neither kinsmen nor companions.”
the bearer of the triple staff, eat the first alms-food?
“For one defeated in battle by the waters,” he replied.
Having made a path for me alone in the terrible wilderness,
he extended his hand to me who had fallen into distress;
through that, I crossed over, though overwhelmed by suffering.
Having come here for this purpose from the realm of Vesāyī in the world of the living,
O dear one, Tirīṭavaccha is worthy of gain.
“Give away the wealth and the sacrifice of this man.
